source_title: Taj, Adani tie up for 8 hotels in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Lucknow & Guwahati - The Times of India
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: In one of the biggest deals in Indian airport-hospitality space, Tata Group's Taj Hotels and Adani Airports have entered into an agreement for eight hotels across four cities -- Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Lucknow and Guwahati. Adani operates the airports in these cities and Taj Group will create a combined inventory of 2,000 rooms in the eight hotels that will span Indian Hotels Co Ltd (IHCL, Taj parent) brands across its luxury to mid scale brands -- Taj, Vivanta, Gateway and Ginger. The latest agreement encompasses three Taj hotels, two Vivanta hotels, one Gateway hotel and two Ginger hotels, providing hospitality offerings across multiple traveller segments.In Mumbai, the portfolio will include a Taj hotel at Terminal 2 - Mumbai airport. In Lucknow, the development will comprise a Vivanta and a Ginger hotel. Ahmedabad will include a Taj and a Vivanta in advance stages of development, while Guwahati will feature a Taj, Gateway and Ginger.
